// diagnostic E1009

Jet.MisplacedRestCapture

A `{name:...}` rest capture isn't the last part of a binary pattern

What

A `{name:...}` rest capture isn't the last part of a binary pattern

Why

A rest capture takes every remaining byte, so nothing can follow it

Fix

Move the binary rest capture to the final pattern position.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.MisplacedRestCapture: Tests/UI/binpat_rest_not_final.stderr.

Error: Jet.MisplacedRestCapture: A `{...}` rest capture must be the last part of a binary pattern
  --> Tests/UI/binpat_rest_not_final.jet:4:16
    |
  4 |         [U8]{"{rest:...}{tail:U8}"} -> { print("x") }
    |                ^^^^^^^^
 Why: The rest capture takes every remaining byte, so nothing can come after it
 Fix: Move the `{name:...}` hole to the end, or give it a fixed width
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.MisplacedRestCapture
